pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. The spatial area of patches is larger and more elongated on the upper flank and base of the neck, transitioning to smaller, more compact shapes toward the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological network. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively uniform across the central flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The 1D contour of the mane shows a low-amplitude, high-frequency serration. The silhouette against the background is jagged with consistent rhythmic spikes.
